title: Introduce session-shadow-replayer and latency-tiling-exporter for low-priority production replay
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Added a new low-priority session replay runner (session-shadow-replayer) and a tiled histogram exporter (latency-tiling-exporter). These are opt-in benchlab tools for evaluating tail interference without affecting primary test traffic.
description: Motivation: We need a safe way to replay production session traces alongside existing synthetic workloads to measure tail amplification and cache interference under realistic multiplexing. The session-shadow-replayer runs as a low-priority, non-blocking runner that mirrors live session characteristics (sequence length, token mix, KV cache priming) and streams telemetry to a new latency-tiling-exporter. The latency-tiling-exporter aggregates latency samples into time-aligned "tiles" (e.g., 1s tiles across N worker shards) and produces per-tile histograms with occupancy/queue-depth annotations so we can correlate microbursts with specific kernel hotpaths.

review_comments: Noah Patel: Nice end-to-end. Two quick asks: (1) can we make the default sample_rate conservative (0.1%) so hosted CI doesn't accidentally run heavy replays? (2) add a small opt-out flag to the runner so Dedicated testbeds can disable it by default.

Sofia Martinez: Responded: default sample_rate set to 0.05% in example config; added --disable-shadow flag to benchlab CLI and a deployment toggle in bench_configs. Also added a guard in ci/pipeline-shadow.yml to only run on a specific runner label.
Jing Wei: Can you add an assertion that shadow traffic never holds exclusive locks longer than N ms? We saw a flake on stage where the replay held a file lock and blocked collectors.
Sofia Martinez: Added a non-blocking file lock wrapper and a test that fails if locks exceed 50ms. Also added metrics to tile metadata to record lock wait times.
Ava Kim: Approve after small nits in docs and variable naming; requested adding a note about privacy — ensure sampled sessions are always sanitized before replaying.
Sofia Martinez: Added a sanitizer pass to kv_prime.py and explicit documentation around PII redaction in docs/bench/session_shadow.md. Marking ready for merge.
